html: Your size doubles in all dimensions, and weight is multiplied by eight. This growth increases size by one category—from Medium to Large, for example. html:
Some special abilities and environmental hazards, such as starvation and the long-term effects of freezing or scorching temperatures, can lead to a special condition called exhaustion. Exhaustion is measured in six levels. An effect can give a creature one or more levels of exhaustion, as specified in the effect's description.

If an already exhausted creature suffers another effect that causes exhaustion, its current level of exhaustion increases by the amount specified in the effect's description.

A creature suffers the effect of its current level of exhaustion as well as all lower levels. For example, a creature suffering level 2 exhaustion has its speed halved and has disadvantage on ability checks.

An effect that removes exhaustion reduces its level as specified in the effect's description, with all exhaustion effects ending if a creature's exhaustion level is reduced below 1.

Finishing a long rest reduces a creature's exhaustion level by 1, provided that the creature has also ingested some food and drink. Also, being raised from the dead reduces a creature's exhaustion level by 1.
name: Exhaustion

html:
If you have inspiration, you can expend it when you make an attack roll, saving throw, or ability check. Spending your inspiration gives you advantage on that roll.

Additionally, if you have inspiration, you can reward another player for good roleplaying, clever thinking, or simply doing something exciting in the game. When another player character does something that really contributes to the story in a fun and interesting way, you can give up your inspiration to give that character inspiration.

html:
• A petrified creature is transformed, along with any nonmagical object it is wearing or carrying, into a solid inanimate substance (usually stone). Its weight increases by a factor of ten, and it ceases aging.
  • The creature is incapacitated, can't move or speak, and is unaware of its surroundings.
  • Attack rolls against the creature have advantage.
  • The creature automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saving throws.
  • The creature has resistance to all damage.
  • The creature is immune to poison and disease, although a poison or disease already in its system is suspended, not neutralized.
name: Petrified

blocks.en: A petrified creature is transformed, along with any nonmagical object it is wearing or carrying, into a solid inanimate substance (usually stone). Its weight increases by a factor of ten, and it ceases aging.
blocks.fr: Une créature pétrifiée est transformée, ainsi que tous les objets non magiques qu’elle porte, en une substance solide et inanimée, généralement de la pierre. Son poids est multiplié par dix et elle cesse de vieillir.

blocks.en: The creature is incapacitated, can't move or speak, and is unaware of its surroundings.
blocks.fr: La créature est Neutralisée, ne peut ni se déplacer ni parler et n’a pas conscience de son environnement.

blocks.en: Attack rolls against the creature have advantage.
blocks.fr: Les jets d’attaque contre la créature ont l’Avantage.

blocks.en: The creature automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saving throws.
blocks.fr: La créature échoue automatiquement aux jets de sauvegarde de Force et de Dextérité.

blocks.en: The creature has resistance to all damage.
blocks.fr: La créature a la Résistance à tous les dégâts.

blocks.en: The creature is immune to poison and disease, although a poison or disease already in its system is suspended, not neutralized.
blocks.fr: La créature est immunisée contre le poison et les maladies. Toutefois, un poison ou une maladie déjà présent dans son organisme est suspendu, et non neutralisé.

html:
• A prone creature's only movement option is to crawl, unless it stands up and thereby ends the condition.
  • The creature has disadvantage on attack rolls.
  • An attack roll against the creature has advantage if the attacker is within 5 feet of the creature. Otherwise, the attack roll has disadvantage.
name: Prone

blocks.en: A prone creature's only movement option is to crawl, unless it stands up and thereby ends the condition.
blocks.fr: Une créature À terre ne peut se déplacer qu’en rampant, à moins de se relever et de mettre ainsi fin à cet état.

blocks.en: The creature has disadvantage on attack rolls.
blocks.fr: La créature subit le Désavantage aux jets d’attaque.

blocks.en: An attack roll against the creature has advantage if the attacker is within 5 feet of the creature. Otherwise, the attack roll has disadvantage.
blocks.fr: Un jet d’attaque contre la créature a l’Avantage si l’attaquant est à 5 feet ou moins d’elle. Dans le cas contraire, ce jet subit le Désavantage.

html:
Restricted Movement. Your only movement options are to crawl or to spend an amount of movement equal to half your Speed (round down) to right yourself and thereby end the condition. If your Speed is 0, you can’t right yourself.

Attacks Affected. You have Disadvantage on attack rolls. An attack roll against you has Advantage if the attacker is within 5 feet of you. Otherwise, that attack roll has Disadvantage.
name: Prone

blocks.en: Restricted Movement. Your only movement options are to crawl or to spend an amount of movement equal to half your Speed (round down) to right yourself and thereby end the condition. If your Speed is 0, you can’t right yourself.
blocks.fr: Déplacement limité. Vos seules possibilités de déplacement sont de ramper ou de dépenser la moitié de votre Vitesse, arrondie à l’inférieur, pour vous relever et mettre fin à cet état. Si votre Vitesse est de 0, vous ne pouvez pas vous relever.

blocks.en: Attacks Affected. You have Disadvantage on attack rolls. An attack roll against you has Advantage if the attacker is within 5 feet of you. Otherwise, that attack roll has Disadvantage.
blocks.fr: Effet sur les attaques. Vous subissez le Désavantage aux jets d’attaque. Un jet d’attaque contre vous a l’Avantage si l’attaquant est à 5 feet ou moins de vous. Dans le cas contraire, ce jet subit le Désavantage.

html: You radiate light for 40 ft (equivalent of a torch).
name: Radiate Light 40

blocks.en: You radiate light for 40 ft (equivalent of a torch).
blocks.fr: Vous émettez de la lumière sur 40 ft, comme une torche.

html: Size is halved in all dimensions, and weight is reduced to one-eighth of normal. This reduction decreases size by one category—from Medium to Small, for example. You have disadvantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws. Weapons also shrink to match its new size. While these weapons are reduced, the target's attacks with them deal 1d4 less damage (this can't reduce the damage below 1).
name: Reduce
source: Source.  Shard Player's Guide Volume 1, D&D 2024 PHB

blocks.en: Size is halved in all dimensions, and weight is reduced to one-eighth of normal. This reduction decreases size by one category—from Medium to Small, for example. You have disadvantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws. Weapons also shrink to match its new size. While these weapons are reduced, the target's attacks with them deal 1d4 less damage (this can't reduce the damage below 1).
blocks.fr: Votre taille est divisée par deux dans toutes les dimensions et votre poids est réduit à un huitième de son poids normal. Cette réduction diminue votre taille d’une catégorie, par exemple de Moyenne à Petite. Vous subissez le Désavantage aux tests de Force et aux jets de sauvegarde de Force. Vos armes rétrécissent aussi pour s’adapter à votre nouvelle taille. Tant qu’elles sont réduites, vos attaques avec ces armes infligent 1d4 dégâts de moins, sans pouvoir réduire les dégâts en dessous de 1.

html: A turned creature must spend its turns trying to move as far away from you as it can, and it can't willingly move to a space within 30 feet of you. It also can't take reactions. For its action, it can use only the Dash action or try to escape from an effect that prevents it from moving. If there's nowhere to move, the creature can use the Dodge action.
name: Turned
source: Source.  Shard Player's Guide Volume 1, D&D 2024 PHB

blocks.en: A turned creature must spend its turns trying to move as far away from you as it can, and it can't willingly move to a space within 30 feet of you. It also can't take reactions. For its action, it can use only the Dash action or try to escape from an effect that prevents it from moving. If there's nowhere to move, the creature can use the Dodge action.
blocks.fr: Une créature renvoyée doit consacrer ses tours à s’éloigner de vous autant que possible et ne peut pas se déplacer volontairement à moins de 30 feet de vous. Elle ne peut pas non plus entreprendre de Réaction. Pour son action, elle ne peut que Foncer ou tenter d’échapper à un effet qui l’empêche de se déplacer. Si elle ne peut aller nulle part, elle peut entreprendre l’action Esquiver.
